Future Forest left my heart full and my brain brimming with inspiration. What we are able to pull off as a team of passionate movers, shakers, and artists always blows me away.

This year I took on an ambitious project that really pushed me out of my comfort zone. The piece was cut from plywood using a Maslow CNC machine and lined with addressable LEDs that were controlled using Artnet from Resolume. I was so pleased with how it turned out in the end.  Watching so many amazing DJs lay it down in front of an art piece that I have been working on for so long really made the struggle all worth it.

Thank you to everyone who helped FF come together. So much love for you all.

Thanks to @anandfriesen and Vessel visuals for piloting the visuals with me.
